summary: Verified the updated print voucher template (Toko Aneka 88 style) in both CreateVoucher and VoucherManagement flows. Screenshot of print media confirms visual match with reference design: dashed top border, 'Toko ANEKA88 MANGON' header with divider lines, VOUCHER BELANJA banner with left/right triangular arrow shapes, NILAI VOUCHER (dynamic Rp 50.000), QR code, rounded pill-shaped terms banner (BELANJA MIN 100RB DAPAT VOUCHER INI), and expiry section with calendar SVG icon showing '31 DESEMBER 2026'. All required elements present and arrow triangle shapes render correctly (2 triangles per template).
critical_code_review_comments: Print template markup (~130 lines) is duplicated verbatim between CreateVoucher.js (lines 284-419) and VoucherManagement.js (lines 315-444). Extract into a shared <PrintVoucher voucher={...} /> component; any future design change needs to be updated in two places.

VoucherManagement.handlePrint still uses a 100ms setTimeout after setSelectedVoucher(); consider useEffect on selectedVoucher change to guarantee the template is rendered before window.print() fires (worked in tests but is timing-fragile).

The 'ANEKA88' header uses a plain <span> around '88' with no distinctive styling from the reference (in the reference the '88' has a filled rounded background). Current output is monochrome text only — visually acceptable for thermal print but not identical to reference.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 voucher 'Voucher Toko Aneka Test' (Rp 50000, terms 'BELANJA MIN 100RB DAPAT VOUCHER INI', expires 2026-12-31)
